name: traitorous_greed_then_village_rites_sacrifices_the_stolen_creature
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (hunt2). P0 steals P1's Ogre with Traitorous Greed (two mana, here BB) and pays Village Rites' additional cost 'sacrifice a creature' with it: a player sacrifices a permanent they control (CR 701.21a), and P0 controls the Ogre, which P1 owns. The Ogre goes to its owner's graveyard and P0 draws two. Failed before the fix: the cost read the controller off the zone that holds the card, which names its owner, so Village Rites was never castable.
